chronology_note: Same audit as E0482 (party_vr96_b); two reachable legends (Chi-Yu, Landorus), no window-90 addition used.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Drought on entry, Solar Beam with no charge or Encore
Bisharp Defiant punishes stat drops (none offered)
Lurantis Contrary Leaf Storm snowball / Synthesis in sun
Mega Raichu X Fake Out / Knock Off closer

attempts.party: party_vr96_b.json led by Chi-Yu + Landorus (Incineroar benched to deny Defiant)
attempts.why: Turn 1 Drought was live; Bisharp Sucker Punched Landorus (168), then Rock Slide + sun-boosted Heat Wave KO'd both Bisharp and Ninetales before Ninetales moved. Turn 2 Lurantis Protected, Dodrio Knock Off hit Landorus' Protect, Heat Wave OHKO'd the Choice-locked Dodrio (287, neutral, in the sun the team set). Turn 3 Flygon Protected, Heat Wave OHKO'd Lurantis (Leaf Storm chosen, never fired). Turn 4 Raichu Fake Out flinched Chi-Yu, Earth Power OHKO'd Raichu before it Mega Evolved; Flygon Tailwind. Turns 5-8 Flygon: Earth Power 188 on Chi-Yu, Overheat missed, Protect once, Sludge Bomb finished it. Zero faints.

strategy_checks.evidence: B_WEATHER_SUN_NORMAL at turn 0; Ninetales chose Heat Wave turn 1 and died before moving; Solar Beam and Encore never used; the sun boosted the player's Chi-Yu Heat Wave to OHKO Dodrio and Lurantis
no stat drop offered; Bisharp Sucker Punched Landorus then died turn 1
Lurantis: Protect turn 2, Leaf Storm chosen turn 3 but OHKO'd first; Synthesis never used
Knock Off chosen into Landorus' Protect turn 2; OHKO'd turn 2 by one neutral Heat Wave (4 HP EVs, sun)
turn 4 Tailwind; Yache never relevant (no Ice)
turn 4 Fake Out on entry without Mega Evolving, then OHKO'd by Earth Power; Mega never happened

protect_ledger.payoff: blocked a lethal sun Heat Wave - good; it died to the same move next turn
blocked Sludge Bomb (resisted) + Heat Wave (~250) - fine
blocked lethal Double-Edge + Sludge Bomb - good, delay only (tailwind expired the same turn)

ai_notes: Raichu using Fake Out without Mega Evolving on its entry turn is a legitimate choice (Fake Out only works on the first turn) but it means the Mega never existed; a Mega-on-entry rule for Fake Out users would fix it. Nothing illegal.

level_changes.why: OHKO'd by one neutral Heat Wave on turn 2

level_change_rationale: Brief step 5: first-try 6-0 with zero faints. The two frailest bodies go +1; the Mega, Bisharp and Lurantis keep their offsets.
cooler: The Contrary/Defiant identity is good on paper, but neither trigger appeared and the sun the team sets is a gift to any opposing Fire attacker (Chi-Yu OHKO'd three members with sun-boosted Heat Wave). The sun team lacks a Water-immune/Fire-resist body: a sun-team Fire type that resists the sun-boosted Fire the player brings (or a Flash Fire Ninetales instead of Drought with Torkoal... no, Drought is the point) - the honest suggestion is one Rock/Water-resist body such as a Chlorophyll-free bulky partner. Sets unchanged.
verification_limit: The +1 on Ninetales and Dodrio cannot be re-verified until the main agent rebuilds.
